notes: All arithmetic wraps modulo 2^64; zero iterations return seed without data access.
Work counts one semantic update or load per iteration, not executed instructions. Actual loop work determines the returned state.
Little-endian only: a zero-extending byte load at the same word address equals the low byte of an ordinary 64-bit load.
Allocated ordinary memory only; no volatile, atomic or concurrent-memory equivalence. All 64-bit accesses are within allocation; the oracle warms data.
LDRB cannot use an index scaled by eight, so candidate forms the address with ADD before loading.
Index is (state >> 8) & mask, scaled by eight; mask 255 and 256 words bound the final 8-byte load to offsets 2040..2047. Data pointer and mask remain unchanged.
